title: What do the public UAP records establish?
summary: The National Archives holds photographs, recordings and written reports about unidentified phenomena. NASA identifies a gap between documenting a sighting and establishing its origin. This reference review explains what each source can support.

sources.name: National Archives · UFO and UAP records

evidence.name: National Archives · UFO and UAP records
evidence.finding: The National Archives catalogs UAP-related photographs, moving images and written records. These holdings document that reports and materials exist.

counterevidence.name: NASA Science · UAP study FAQ
counterevidence.finding: NASA says available evidence does not support an extraterrestrial origin for UAP. It also reports that too few high-quality observations are available to draw broad scientific conclusions.
